background.name_join: Exact OSM element type/id match to the original Overpass response; no geocoding, translation or inference.
processing: Fetched using OSMnx features_from_polygon with the recorded union tags.
Excluded features tagged building or building:part; retained lines for roads, polygons for parks and land use, and lines/polygons for water.
Reprojected to EPSG:5179 and intersected with the exact 400 metre square AOI.
Retained original geometry, classification and identifiers from the acquired file; added only recorded OSM names and selected tags.
interpretation_notes: Road geometries are centerlines, not inferred road-surface polygons.
The water class may include covered or tunnel waterways; preserved tags indicate these cases.
Zero park features means none retained by this OSM query, not an independently verified absence.
background.validation: 126 features; CRS, geometry and classification match acquisition exactly; all geometries remain inside AOI.
